title: Build local FastAPI GraphQL workspace with SQLite run history and interactive labeling

comments.author: home
comments.text: Architecture recorded in docs/web-workspace-plan.md. API is the authoritative event source: runner must ingest exact requests/responses, triggers, labels, configurations and fitting/metrics via GraphQL with commit acknowledgements, stable identities and cursor reconnect. React/shadcn retains current timeline inspector. SQLite run catalog and serialized durable commands drive the existing engine. No new flywheel. Live confirmation/ceilings, protected comments excluded, undo retained. Objective comparisons wait for web-cycle acceptance.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented local FastAPI/Strawberry GraphQL application, SQLite catalog/events/jobs/items, acknowledged idempotent GraphQLTraceSink, cursor subscriptions, arXiv label/comment/undo UI, serialized existing-engine worker, and API-backed recorded timeline. Engine optimizer context and decision exchanges tested end-to-end through API with fake clients. Offline export and online client bundles are separated. Local app runs on 8782; one real prediction is being checked without submitting human labels. Remaining: full browser optimization cycle, incremental live timeline updates, operator recovery for failed trace delivery, objective comparison runs and protected audit reports.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Browser verification succeeded: recorded history and protected before/after metrics rendered from API-owned SQLite data; subscription showed Connected. No human votes submitted. Fake integration separately verifies optimizer request includes human explanations and optimizer response plus decision request/response persist via GraphQL. 570 Python and 11 frontend tests pass. Not yet complete: live optimizer cycle browser verification, incremental live timeline, failure-delivery recovery and matched objective comparisons.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Restored the web run explorer: open existing optimizer history by default, retain selected run/view in URL, expose per-run cycle/label/optimizer counts, identify Interactive vs Replay, remove Local/GraphQL/SQLite badge and duplicate embedded headers, show loading feedback, and prevent hidden item-panel scrolling from separating events from lane labels. Added reusable unfinished-cycle resume and worker restart test: feedback references the original displayed prediction and cycle with zero repeated model calls. Browser verified replay has 87 cycles/87 labels/11 optimizer calls and clicking rubric cell opens exact request 201/response 202. 573 Python and 16 frontend specs pass. Plan now explicitly defines shared engine/events for interactive and frozen-label replay input sources. In-app replay launching/parameter controls and incremental timeline updates remain unfinished; do not treat imported playback as completion of replay execution controls.
